in_sanskrit.name: मानिशंकर
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who possesses the mind of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मान: mind, शंक: to think, कर: to do. One who possesses the mind of Shiva.

in_hindi.name: मानिशंकर
in_hindi.meaning: व्यक्ति जो शिव के मन का स्थान पहुँचाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मान: मन, शंक: सोचना, कर: करना. शिव के मन का स्थान वाला व्यक्ति.

in_tamil.name: மானிஷங்கர்

in_tamil.long_meaning: மான்: மனம், ஷங்கர்: ஶிவன். ஶிவன் இன் மனத்தில் உள்ள ஓங்கம் உள்ள மனிதன்.

in_telugu.name: మానిశంఖర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: మాని: మనస్, శంఖర్: శివ. శివ మనస్య పోయుదు మనషీ.

in_marathi.name: Manishankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mindful, Wise, Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manishankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mani (jewel, gem) + Ishankar (God Shankara, Lord of all), signifying a wise and mindful being who is protected by Lord Shankara.

in_bengali.name: Manishankar

data.cultural_impact: The name "Manishankar" is a combination of the Sanskrit words "mani," meaning a jewel or precious gem, and "ishankar," signifying Lord Shankara, the supreme being in the Shaivite tradition of Hinduism. The name has a rich cultural significance as it suggests a noble and valuable individual, often associated with the idea of wisdom, intellect, and fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Hindu philosophical context, the name Manishankar conveys a deeper spiritual sense. Mani symbolizes wisdom, understanding, and the pursuit of knowledge, while Ishankar represents the ultimate divine protector, Lord Shankara.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Manishankar was a famous king in the 13th century in the southern Indian kingdom of Vijayanagara. The name Manishankar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Manishankar remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Manishankar from Mumbai, India embodies the meaning of Manishankar - "Mindful, Wise, Goddess of Fortune". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Manishankar: One who controls the mind (Manas) and is devoted to Shankara, the form of Shiva that represents detachment and liberation.
